acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By using the Nomli application, you accept these Terms of Service (ToS). If you do not accept these terms, please do not use the application.

account.title: 2. Account Creation
account.content:
To use Nomli, you must create an account by providing accurate and up-to-date information. You are responsible for the confidentiality of your login credentials.

You must:
- Be at least 18 years old
- Provide truthful information
- Not create multiple accounts
- Not impersonate others

usage.title: 3. Acceptable Use
usage.content:
You agree to use Nomli responsibly and respectfully. It is forbidden to:
- Post offensive, defamatory or illegal content
- Harass or threaten other users
- Use the application for unauthorized commercial purposes
- Collect data from other users without their consent
- Attempt to bypass security measures

content.title: 4. User Content
content.content:
You retain ownership of the content you post on Nomli. However, you grant Nomli a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use, reproduce and distribute your content as part of the operation of the application.

Nomli reserves the right to remove any content that violates these ToS.

premium.title: 5. Premium Services
premium.content:
Nomli offers premium features accessible through a paid subscription of €4.99 per month or €39.99 per year.

The subscription is:
- Billed monthly or annually
- Auto-renewable
- Cancellable at any time

No refunds will be provided for unused periods.

termination.title: 6. Suspension and Termination
termination.content:
Nomli reserves the right to suspend or terminate your account at any time in case of violation of these ToS, without notice or compensation.

You can also delete your account at any time from the application settings.

modifications.title: 7. Modifications to ToS
modifications.content: Nomli reserves the right to modify these ToS at any time. Users will be informed of significant changes via the application or by email.

law.title: 8. Applicable Law
law.content: These ToS are governed by French law. In case of dispute, French courts shall have sole jurisdiction.
